edits.new:
Then a drift between a fake and this document fails the contract test, and the four fake fixtures are synthetic

  Scenario: AC7 Each business rule of section 8 has a criterion and a test (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the business rules BR1 to BR9 of section 8
    When each rule is reviewed against the criteria of section 7 and the test cases of section 16
    Then each of BR1 to BR9 is covered by at least one criterion of section 7 and by one test case of section 16
    Then a rule with no criterion or no test is refused at the contract review

  Scenario: AC8 A resource the contract does not provide answers 404 (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the operations of this contract on the base /api/recovery/agent/v1
    When a caller asks for a resource that the contract does not provide
    Then the answer is 404 and no other status is given for that resource
    Then each provided operation declares 404 among its error answers, and a contract test fails when one does not
